description:
Return the fix-it prompt the web UI's 'Generate prompt for
everything wrong' button produces for a branch — the common-case
one-shot for "fix everything broken here". Resolves the repo +
branch, finds the latest analysis, generates (or fetches a cached)
bulk prompt, and waits up to ``wait_seconds`` for completion.

``repository`` is required — pass the GitHub 'owner/repo' for the
project the user is working in. You (the MCP client) almost always
know this from the working directory's git remote, the open
workspace, or the conversation; pass it explicitly rather than
calling ``list_repositories`` first. A repo UUID is also accepted
for callers that already have one.

``branch`` defaults to the repository's default branch.

``scope`` selects what to aggregate (default ``"everything"``):
  - ``untested`` — all functions with no tests yet
  - ``partial`` — all functions only partially covered
  - ``failing`` — all failing tests
  - ``everything`` — failing tests + all untested + partial functions
  - ``frontend`` — TypeScript components grouped with the handlers and
    render branches inside them that nothing exercises yet;
    Playwright/React-Testing-Library oriented rather than a flat
    function list

Returns the same shape as ``get_bulk_prompt`` — on cache hit /
completed generation, ``{status: "completed", prompt_text, ...}``;
on timeout, ``{status: "pending", generation_id}`` so you can
resume via ``wait_for_prompt``.
name: fix_branch
